exposure: Preterm births (PTBs) categorized as: iatrogenic procedures, spontaneous preterm labors, and preterm premature ruptures of the membranes (pPROMs)
cohort: 11,769 women with singleton births at an Italian hospital
finding: Singleton pregnancies conceived through ART were associated with a higher risk of preterm birth, particularly due to an increased incidence of pPROM and spontaneous preterm labor.
